name: Unidentified weapons inspection droid
description: A weapons inspection droid served in BG-RT's Tavern and Spirits, a cantina on Level 1313 of the planet Coruscant collecting weapons from those that entered the establishment. When the bounty hunter Beilert Valance led several fellow hunters to the cantina, the weapons inspection droid witnessed the shootout that began after Valance killed Xonr, one of his pursuers.
